searches.B: ("Jio Platforms" OR "Reliance Jio" OR "Reliance Jio Infocomm" OR "Reliance Retail Ventures" OR "Reliance Retail" OR "Reliance Consumer Products" OR "Reliance New Energy")

company_scope:
News about any of these counts as news about Reliance Industries, including their subsidiaries and current products:
- Reliance Industries Limited: Oil-to-chemicals (refining, fuels, petrochemicals), oil and gas, and the parent of the digital, retail and new energy businesses
- Jio Platforms Limited: Telecom and digital services through Reliance Jio Infocomm; listed on 28 October 2026, still controlled by Reliance Industries
- Reliance Retail Ventures Limited: Retail stores and online shopping through Reliance Retail
- Reliance Consumer Products Limited: Consumer brands (food, drinks and personal care)
- Reliance New Energy Limited: Solar, batteries and other new energy businesses
Other companies with a similar name or from the same business group are separate businesses.
sample_rule: Search A (up to 30 articles), then search B (up to 30), merged in that order; each article kept once by tidy link; articles published outside the window or without a date are excluded and logged; the sample is what remains, even when it is small or unbalanced: no top-up and no replacement. An article whose page cannot be fetched stays and is labelled on its short text.

definitions.relevant_event: an event with at least one article labelled direct or indirect
definitions.direct_event: an event with at least one article labelled direct
definitions.event_recall: distinct relevant events among the relevant articles in the top k, divided by the relevant events among the articles Stage 1 keeps; undefined when there is no relevant event
definitions.precision: relevant articles among the selected articles, divided by the number selected (k, or fewer when fewer articles are available; the number available is reported)
definitions.no_direct_event_lost: every direct event that O1's top 10 covers is also covered by O1+S1's top 10, on the same articles and the same event names
definitions.model_coverage: the share of the articles Stage 1 keeps that have a model answer after the first live pass, started with no saved answers; it applies only to configurations that use the model
definitions.model_time: the seconds of that first pass; it applies only to configurations that use the model
definitions.summary_event_coverage: event rows marked covered = yes, divided by all event rows: one row per relevant event among the summary's own top 5 articles (SUMMARY_JUDGING_GUIDE.md, Part 3)
definitions.contradicted_rate: items with contradicted = yes, divided by all judged items (company points, industry points and visible article briefs)
definitions.produced: the one summary comes out (1 of 1)

ranking.note: the Tata 'gain' condition is not used: it decided whether O1+S1 replaces the baseline, which is settled; this test checks that the default does no worse on a new company

reported_without_level: the relevance check against the labels

reading.candidate_pool: event recall is recall within the articles Stage 1 keeps, not within all news published about the company
reading.one_summary: the test judges one summary for factual support, event coverage and completion; it does not establish production reliability across repeated searches
reading.no_tuning: Reliance labels and results do not change the pipeline, the Stage 4 design or any setting; an experimental configuration never becomes the default because of this test
reading.fixes: a failure is reported with its diagnosis; a fix is built and tested on Tata Motors development data only, then checked on a new, unseen Reliance week
reading.balance: a sample with few indirect or not articles is reported as it is; the searches are not changed
